Shipping & returns

Every piece is handmade to order. Orders placed through October 31 (Halloween rush): 10–15 business days to make. Orders placed after October 31: 5–7 business days to make. Orders then ship free by USPS Ground Advantage (about 2–5 business days in transit) to all 50 U.S. states. International shipping is not available.

Returns are accepted within 30 days for items that are new and unused. The buyer pays return shipping, there is no restocking fee, and the refund is issued to your original payment method within 7 business days of the returned item arriving. We do not offer exchanges.
